instructions:
Groundworkers gives deterministic access to an OMOP vocabulary: search, grounding, the concept graph and convention packs. system_status shows what is available.

Before mapping, load conventions once per job: knowledge_catalogue with the domains involved, then knowledge_pack for each pack that applies. Pack rules override habit.

To map a source term:
1. Note every qualifier it states (specimen, site, laterality, route, form, unit, method).
2. Gather candidates with concept_candidate_bundle; keep standard concepts in the right domain.
3. Check the hierarchy before deciding (concept_mapping_context, concept_descendants): pick the most detailed standard concept the source supports. A child that keeps a stated qualifier beats its parent; never add detail the source lacks.
4. Vocabulary is not a preference by itself; packs decide between equally precise concepts.
5. No fit: concept_nearest_standard_ancestor, or say no standard concept fits.

prompts.description: Return the message sequence for rewriting source text into a clean OMOP-grounding search phrase.
prompts.name: cleanup_mapping_text

prompts.description: Return the message sequence for decomposing a free-text clinical description into a list of normalized search terms.
prompts.name: decompose_clinical_text

prompts.description: Return the message sequence for listing all plausible clinical interpretations of an ambiguous term or abbreviation.
prompts.name: disambiguate_clinical_term

prompts.description: Return the message sequence for normalizing a clinical term, abbreviation, or lay phrase to its OMOP-compatible equivalent.
prompts.name: normalize_clinical_term

resources.description: Sanitised view of the active server configuration: which adapters are wired up (omop_graph, omop_emb, llm), their key settings, and the effective min_fulltext_overlap. API keys are masked.
resources.name: active_config

resources.description: List all locally available embedding models with their backend type, provider, dimensions, and indexed concept count.
resources.name: embedding_models

resources.description: Full index of all available knowledge packs across all namespaces (core, specialisation, source, localisation). Each entry includes name, layer, version, shareability, scope_summary, mechanisms, applicability conditions, and see_also cross-references. Read this to understand what knowledge is available before querying with knowledge_catalogue. Use knowledge_catalogue to filter by job context.
resources.name: knowledge_catalogue_resource

resources.description: Authoritative Tier A canonical header catalogue used for deterministic source-planning classification.
resources.name: source_planning_canonical_headers

resources.description: ColumnRole values and descriptions for interpreting annotated source-planning outputs.
resources.name: source_planning_column_roles

resources.description: IngestionStrategy values and descriptions for interpreting source-planning route decisions.
resources.name: source_planning_ingestion_strategies

resources.description: Full OMOP vocabulary/domain/concept-class catalogue with concept counts. Read this before filtering searches by vocabulary or domain. Requires omop_graph to be configured.
resources.name: vocabularies_catalogue

tools.description:
List broader concepts above a concept (stored OMOP hierarchy). Use it to check whether a
candidate is more specific than the source supports, or to find a generalisation when no
exact match exists. max_depth bounds stored separation, not hops; zero separation does
not mean the concepts are interchangeable.
tools.name: concept_ancestors

tools.description:
List a concept's clinical or therapeutic association edges (for example regimen to
component drugs, drug to indication), each with the related concept's standard flag.
Defining attributes such as finding site are ATTRIBUTE edges; use concept_neighbors for
those.
tools.name: concept_associations

tools.description:
Look up one concept by vocabulary_id and concept_code. Use it for codes that appear in
the source data or in tool results. Codes recalled from memory are often wrong; to find
a concept by its meaning, search with concept_candidate_bundle.

concept_code.description: The code as it appears in that vocabulary.
concept_code.title: Concept Code

vocabulary_id.description: Exact vocabulary_id, for example ICD10CM or LOINC.
vocabulary_id.title: Vocabulary Id

tools.name: concept_by_code

tools.description:
Default first search for a source term. Runs exact, normalized, full-text and embedding
search together and returns one deduplicated candidate list; retrieved_by shows which
channels found each candidate. Pass domain when known. Candidates are leads: check
standard_concept and domain_id, then the hierarchy (concept_mapping_context,
concept_descendants) before choosing.

domain.description: OMOP domain_id to restrict to, for example Measurement, Drug or Condition. Use it when known.
domain.title: Domain

include_hierarchy_context.description: Attach ancestors to the first five candidates (larger output).
include_hierarchy_context.title: Include Hierarchy Context

include_relationship_summary.description: Attach a relationship summary to the first five candidates (larger output).
include_relationship_summary.title: Include Relationship Summary

include_standard_mappings.description: Attach each candidate's Maps-to standard concept(s).
include_standard_mappings.title: Include Standard Mappings

model_name.description: Embedding model; omit to use the configured default.
model_name.title: Model Name

overall_limit.description: Maximum candidates in the merged list.
overall_limit.title: Overall Limit

parent_ids.description: Keep only descendants of these concept_ids. Applies to the exact, normalized and full-text channels, not embedding.
parent_ids.title: Parent Ids

query.description: The source term text, as written.
query.title: Query

standard_only.description: true returns only standard concepts. The default false also returns non-standard hits (with their standard mapping when include_standard_mappings is true).
standard_only.title: Standard Only

tools.name: concept_candidate_bundle

tools.description:
List more specific concepts below a concept (stored OMOP hierarchy, up to max_depth
levels). Use it after picking a candidate, to check whether a more specific standard
concept matches every qualifier the source states (for example specimen, site, route or
form). Each result has domain_id, standard_concept and depth. Results are ordered by depth
then concept_id; limit defaults to 50 (range 1..500), offset defaults to 0, and the response
includes total, returned and truncated.

concept_class_ids.description: Only descendants in these concept classes, for example ['Clinical Drug']. Use for drugs, where depth is not specificity.
concept_class_ids.title: Concept Class Ids

max_depth.description: Levels below to include (hierarchy hops). Default 3.
max_depth.title: Max Depth

tools.name: concept_descendants

tools.description:
Shortest equivalence path between two concepts over identity edges (Maps to, same_as,
cross-vocabulary equivalence and replacement links). With
allow_hierarchical_traversal=true it may also step up or down the hierarchy, so the link
found can be broader than an exact equivalence.
tools.name: concept_equivalency_path

tools.description:
Raw single-hop hierarchy edges from concept_relationship, including classification (for
example ATC) and cross-vocabulary links. Use concept_ancestors or concept_descendants
for ordinary is-a questions; use this only for classification membership or
cross-vocabulary hierarchy edges.
tools.name: concept_extended_inheritance

tools.description:
Look up one concept by concept_id: name, vocabulary, domain, class and standard flag.
Use it to verify a candidate before answering. To find concepts from text, use
concept_candidate_bundle.
tools.name: concept_get

tools.description:
Quick resolver: ranked candidates from the first resolver tier that matches (exact, then
full-text, then embedding, then partial), so it can stop at a short or broad name. Use
it for a fast lead; use concept_candidate_bundle for a broad candidate set. By default
non-standard matches are resolved to standard via Maps to (standardized_from shows the
source). classification_concept ('C') results are hierarchy nodes, not mapping targets.

active_only.description: Exclude deprecated or upgraded concepts from candidate resolution.
active_only.title: Active Only

domain.description: OMOP domain_id to restrict to, when known.
domain.title: Domain

parent_ids.description: Keep only descendants of these concept_ids.
parent_ids.title: Parent Ids

standard_only.description: Restrict candidate resolution to concepts flagged 'S' or 'C'. The default false resolves non-standard matches to standard via Maps to.
standard_only.title: Standard Only

tools.name: concept_ground

tools.description:
Resolve a vocabulary_id and concept_code (for example a source code) to its standard
concept(s) via identity relationships, which include Maps to value; for the Maps to
target alone, use concept_navigate_to_standard.
tools.name: concept_map_to_standard

tools.description: Return "Maps to value" target concepts for a given vocabulary/code pair.
tools.name: concept_map_to_value

tools.description:
One-call review of a candidate before committing to it: standard mapping, ancestors,
relationship summary and graph neighbours. Set include_descendants=true to also list
more specific concepts.

model_name.description: Embedding model; omit to use the configured default.
model_name.title: Model Name

tools.name: concept_mapping_context

tools.description:
Resolve concept_ids (for example non-standard search hits) to their standard equivalents
via Maps to, in one call. Standard concepts return themselves; unmapped concepts return
[]; unknown ids are omitted.
tools.name: concept_navigate_to_standard

tools.description:
When no standard concept matches the source at its precision, find the closest broader
standard concept, from a concept_id or a free-text query. Equally near candidates are
reported as ambiguous.

candidate_limit.description: Maximum grounded seeds retrieved in query mode.
candidate_limit.title: Candidate Limit

parent_ids.description: Keep only grounded seeds in query mode that are descendants of these concept_ids.
parent_ids.title: Parent Ids

query.description: Free text to ground first (use this or concept_id).
query.title: Query

vocabulary_id.description: Restrict grounded seeds in query mode to one exact vocabulary_id.
vocabulary_id.title: Vocabulary Id

tools.name: concept_nearest_standard_ancestor

tools.description:
Breadth-first exploration of everything linked to a concept across all relationship
types (hierarchy, identity, attribute, composition, association), up to 4 hops. Use it
to discover related concepts when you do not know which relationship connects them, for
example a procedure's site and method (predicate_kinds=["ATTRIBUTE"], max_depth=1).
tools.name: concept_neighbors

tools.description:
Shortest path between two known concepts over any relationship type. within_domain=true
(default) keeps both ends of every edge in one domain; set it false to cross domains
through attribute edges such as finding site.
tools.name: concept_path

tools.description:
Returns all relationships for a concept grouped by direction (inbound/outbound).

Edges are not filtered by domain, so cross-domain attribute edges are
included: e.g. a Procedure's "Has method" (-> Observation), "Has dir
proc site" (-> Spec Anatomic Site) and "Has dir device" (-> Device).
tools.name: concept_relationships

tools.description:
Resolve a structured mapping expression to standard OMOP concepts.

Accepts a list of items each specifying a vocabulary_id and concept_code (or
concept_id). Resolves each to its standard equivalent(s) and optionally
deduplicates the combined result set. Useful for batch-resolving a pre-defined
concept set from source vocabulary codes.
tools.name: concept_resolve_mapping_expression

tools.description:
Exact, case-insensitive match on concept name or synonym. concept_candidate_bundle
already runs this channel; call it directly only to confirm that an exact name exists.
Returns non-standard concepts too; check standard_concept.

query.description: Exact name or synonym to match.
query.title: Query

tools.name: concept_search_exact

tools.description:
Ranked word-based search on concept names (PostgreSQL full text).
concept_candidate_bundle already runs this channel; call it directly to see more
full-text results or to set min_rank. Returns non-standard concepts too. If
tsvector_available is false, results are always empty.
tools.name: concept_search_fulltext

tools.description:
Near-verbatim search after normalizing punctuation and whitespace; deterministic,
unranked. concept_candidate_bundle already runs this channel; call it directly only for
a strict near-exact check.

NormalizationProfile.description: Supported normalization contracts shared by Python and SQL callers.
NormalizationProfile.title: NormalizationProfile

allow_unindexed_scan.description: Allow a slow unscoped scan when no normalized index exists.
allow_unindexed_scan.title: Allow Unindexed Scan

parent_ids.description: Keep only descendants of these concept_ids.
parent_ids.title: Parent Ids

remove_stop_phrases.description: Strip common stop phrases before matching.
remove_stop_phrases.title: Remove Stop Phrases

tools.name: concept_search_normalized

tools.description:
Find common active standard ancestors of alternative candidates for one source.

Supply 2..200 positive concept IDs in the same domain (at least two distinct).
Class/vocabulary filters apply before selection; null means unrestricted;
empty or unknown filters are invalid. Exact vocabulary IDs are required:
RxNorm does not include RxNorm Extension. Use system_vocabulary_catalogue
to discover available identifiers.

max_depth=0..20 measures stored minimum separation, not parent hops.
Distinct zero-distance ancestors count, and each seed counts as itself.
Returns selected, ambiguous, no_match or incompatible_inputs. found means
a unique selection, not simply the existence of common ancestry.
limit/offset page the complete common set and never change selection.

A shared ancestor is a generalization, not proof of equivalence or clinical
correctness. Do not merge separate combination-drug ingredients with this
operation. Deterministic for a fixed vocabulary; no LLM/embeddings required.
tools.name: concept_shared_standard_ancestor

tools.description:
Model-based guess of where data-dictionary fields belong: Measurement, Condition,
Observation, Procedure, Drug, Device, or the non-OMOP labels Metadata (administrative
fields such as site codes or form dates) and Identifier (record-linkage IDs). Uses each
label and its first 10 example values. Unassigned labels are omitted; there is no
confidence score.

label_values.description: Map of field label to example values; the first 10 per label are used.
label_values.title: Label Values

tools.name: domain_classify

tools.description:
Return the raw embedding vector for a text, using the configured embedding model. For
diagnostics only: embedding_search encodes internally. The vector is large.

model_name.description: Omit to use the configured live model; no other model is accepted.
model_name.title: Model Name

tools.name: embedding_encode

tools.description: Returns status of the embedding backend and registered models.
tools.name: embedding_index_status

tools.description:
Returns nearest embedding-space neighbours for one OMOP concept.

The default uses the partial vector index on is_standard AND is_valid. Pass
standard_only=False to include non-standard neighbours, at the cost of a full scan.
tools.name: embedding_neighbours

tools.description:
Semantic search by meaning. Use it for abbreviations, paraphrases, misspellings or
non-English terms that word-based search misses. Similar meaning is not equivalence:
confirm hits with concept_get and the hierarchy.

model_name.description: Embedding model; omit to use the configured default.
model_name.title: Model Name

query.description: Text to search for by meaning.
query.title: Query

tools.name: embedding_search

tools.description:
Search the embedding index for multiple queries in one batch.

All queries share the same search filters. Use separate calls when
domain, vocabulary, or model constraints differ.
tools.name: embedding_search_batch

tools.description:
Find the convention packs (OMOP and OHDSI conventions, plus local site rules) that apply
to a job. Call it once at the start of any mapping or review job, with the OMOP domains
involved, before choosing between candidates; then read each applicable pack with
knowledge_pack. Returns name, scope_summary and see_also for each pack.

domains.description: OMOP domains involved in the job, for example ["Measurement", "Drug"].
domains.title: Domains

layer.description: Restrict to core, specialisation, source or localisation.
layer.title: Layer

section_names.description: Section names from the source, used to detect a specialty.
section_names.title: Section Names

source_system.description: Detected source system (from source_plan), if any.
source_system.title: Source System

tools.name: knowledge_catalogue

tools.description:
Read one convention pack by name (from knowledge_catalogue): its guidance text and
rules, for example which concept level or vocabulary applies when candidates are equally
precise. Apply its rules to the decision; they override general habit.

name.description: Pack name from knowledge_catalogue, for example standard-concept-preference.
name.title: Name

tools.name: knowledge_pack

tools.description:
Score predicted mappings against reference mappings: accuracy (the reference standard
concept_id is among the first top_k predictions), coverage and agreement cases,
optionally by domain. An evaluation utility; concept_ids are not checked against the
vocabulary.

predicted_mappings.description: Rows with source_key (or source_id or source_term), predicted_standard_concept_ids as a ranked list, optional domain_id.
predicted_mappings.title: Predicted Mappings

reference_mappings.description: Rows with source_key (or source_id or source_term), reference_standard_concept_id (required), optional domain_id.
reference_mappings.title: Reference Mappings

top_k.description: Count a match within the first top_k predictions; omit to use all.
top_k.title: Top K

tools.name: mapping_evaluate_candidates

tools.description:
Plan submitted source content into neutral grounding artifacts.

Accepts source content as UTF-8 text by default. Pass
``content_encoding="base64"`` when submitting binary formats such as
XLSX, PDF, or DOCX. The result always includes the final
``IngestionPlan`` and may optionally include intermediate raw,
normalized, and annotated tables for inspection.
tools.name: source_plan

tools.description:
source_plan plus a language-model review of the tables the rules could not classify
confidently; use it after source_plan when plan.uncertain_tables is not empty. Returns
BACKEND_UNAVAIL when no language model is configured or model-assisted planning is
turned off.

caller_hint.description: Your format guess; only compared with the detection, never changes it.
caller_hint.title: Caller Hint

content.description: File content: raw text, or base64 (with content_encoding=base64) for xlsx, pdf or docx.
content.title: Content

tools.name: source_plan_assisted

tools.description:
Health of each configured backend (overall: healthy, degraded or unavailable). Call it
when a capability seems missing.
tools.name: system_status

tools.description: Returns all OMOP vocabularies, domains, and concept classes.
tools.name: system_vocabulary_catalogue

tools.description:
Language-model split of free text naming several concepts (criteria, note excerpts) into
the distinct clinical terms it states, each normalised, to ground one by one with
concept_candidate_bundle. The terms are model text, not OMOP concepts; max_terms is a
request to the model, not an enforced limit.

domain_hint.description: Optional context such as a domain name; it guides the model and is not a filter.
domain_hint.title: Domain Hint

tools.name: text_decompose

tools.description:
Language-model list of the plausible meanings of an ambiguous term or abbreviation, most
likely first given the context (no frequency data is used), with is_ambiguous. Ground
each meaning separately; max_interpretations is a request to the model, not an enforced
limit.

domain_hint.description: Optional context such as a domain name; it guides the model and is not a filter.
domain_hint.title: Domain Hint

tools.name: text_disambiguate

tools.description:
Language-model rewrite of one data-dictionary label or value into the best single search
phrase, removing form noise (scoring syntax, code prefixes, duplicated fragments) while
keeping meaning and specificity. Returns the phrase, a confidence and the model's own
changed flag.

context.description: Optional object with surrounding information, for example the parent label, sibling values or source code.
context.title: Context

tools.name: text_mapping_cleanup

tools.description:
Language-model expansion of a short term: clear abbreviations, lay wording and obvious
misspellings, keeping meaning and specificity. Use it when word-based search fails on
shorthand; embedding search already tolerates much of this. Returns the normalised text
with a confidence.

domain_hint.description: Optional context, used only to resolve ambiguity.
domain_hint.title: Domain Hint

tools.name: text_normalize
